scope.scannerPackageSet: Package, lockfile, and source indicators for pre-execution review.
scope.currentCampaignContext: OX Security reported a DPRK-linked npm infostealer/RAT campaign involving terminal-logger-utils and dependent packages pretty-logger-utils, ts-logger-pack, and pinno-loggers. GitHub Advisory GHSA-m3gw-x6rc-fp3r reports csc154-internall-depend as npm malware with all versions affected. GitHub Advisory GHSA-vqg9-785x-8j39 reports @validate-sdk/v2 as npm malware with all versions affected. GitHub Advisory GHSA-g6v5-9xpp-6hpx reports google-cloud-secret-manager-config-poc as npm malware with all versions affected. Panther reports an April 2026 OtterCookie npm campaign using wrapper/payload packages with exact malicious versions and Vercel-hosted C2 infrastructure. JFrog reports Solana FakeFix and CMS Windows loader npm/PyPI packages targeting Solana keys, SSH keys, cloud credentials, source-control tokens, wallet files, and Windows persistence. Socket reports GlassWASM trojanized Open VSX extensions using suspicious WASM payloads, TinyGo/WebAssembly host code, Solana memo dead-drop retrieval, and child-process download/execute loaders. This checker detects those package names and selected behavior indicators.
